graph: hidden_states -> input_layernorm (WrappedTorchNorm or TE fused residual-RMSNorm) -> attention/MLP branch
branch output with optional bias -> BDA: residual + dropout(x + bias) -> residual merge
separation: BDA is called around branch outputs; it is not implicitly part of the non-TE RMSNorm call.
te_tuple_behavior: When TE fused residual RMSNorm is active, TransformerLayer receives normalized output and a residual fork; non-TE WrappedTorchNorm returns normalization output only.
